Father is on blood pressure medication and advised him against starting. Strong stated aversion to medication. Self-describes as 30 to almost 40 pounds over his ideal weight of 185 lb; current weight never stated.

offer.payment_plan_terms: $1,200 per month for six months, which totals $7,200 against the $6,000 headline — a $1,200 surcharge for instalments, the same structure quoted on the Edward Garcia call. The discrepancy was never explained here and the prospect appears not to have registered it: he said of the $6,000, 'that's only a thousand a month', and the rep did not correct him, yet the plan discussed and agreed in principle was $1,200 a month. A refundable $100 deposit was also offered as a commitment device — 'the deposit is just a hundred, and it's only really to keep you accountable to yourself' — and was not taken.

outcome.next_step: Follow-up Zoom the next day at 2pm Central after his overnight shift, by which point he will have reviewed bank statements and confirmed whether his assignment continues; rep to either start him or 'find another way'.

notable.note: Best-run discovery in the batch — full baseline, a genuine emotional why driven all the way to the granddaughters and great-grandparent legacy, and the most complete money conversation of any call here. Three things to flag anyway. First, the instalment maths: $1,200 x 6 = $7,200 against a $6,000 headline, and the prospect said aloud 'that's only a thousand a month' without being corrected, so he may arrive at the next call believing he agreed to something $1,200 cheaper than what was offered. Second, the rep used a scarcity line that was not true — 'usually, we don't really book in another meeting... unless we actually have a deposit' — and then booked the meeting anyway with no deposit, which teaches the prospect the pressure is soft. Third, the prospect volunteered that he holds a Roth account and stock investments and the rep never followed up, despite that being the last item on the scripted financial picture and the most likely source of $6,000. Also: the rep addressed him as 'Trevor' once at 00:38:21, and the prospect's surname is never stated anywhere in the transcript.
